team.title: Team and access
team.subtitle: Who works in the clinic, with which role and which professional license.
team.search: Search by name, e-mail or license
team.form.name: Full name
team.form.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. The person uses it to sign in to their own account.
team.form.roleHint: Permissions come from the {{role}} role. To change what the person can do, change the role.
team.form.licenseHint: A veterinarian's license is required to prescribe, sign progress notes and discharge.
team.form.activeHint: Deactivating removes the person from the lists and blocks sign-in, but keeps everything they already recorded.
team.pinExplain: Four digits. It is what the person types at the station before recording a dose, and the system stores only the cryptographic digest.
team.pinDuplicate: This PIN already belongs to someone else in the clinic. Pick another: two identical PINs would make it impossible to tell who acted.
team.pinFooter: Changing the PIN does not alter anything already recorded.
team.footer: Every clinical action, from a dose given to a progress note or a discharge, records the name and professional licence of whoever typed the PIN. That is what appears in the audit trail and in the documents.
team.roleSummary.vet: Prescribes, signs progress notes and discharges; runs tasks, admits, builds the rota, sees the bill and the audit trail. Does not configure the clinic, manage the team or the prices.
team.roleSummary.tech: Runs shift tasks, registers patients, contacts owners and opens kennels. Does not prescribe, sign progress notes, discharge, or see the bill or the audit trail.
team.roleSummary.admin: Configures the clinic, manages the team, the prices and the audit trail, and builds the rota. Does not execute clinical tasks, does not prescribe and does not discharge, not even as the clinic's owner.
team.abilitiesSource: Permissions come from the role and the server decides them: this screen does not invent what anyone can do.
team.emptyHint: Invite the first professional so the shift has someone to sign and someone to execute.
team.emptySearchHint: Clear the search to see the whole team.
team.schedule.title: Shift rota
team.schedule.hint: Who is responsible for each shift this week. A red block is a shift with no responsible vet, and the line across today is now.
team.schedule.emptyHint: Put someone on the rota for the coming days: with no shift scheduled there is nobody to hand over to.
team.schedule.timezoneHint: Times are on the clinic's clock ({{zone}}).
team.schedule.onlyVetResponsible: Only someone with the vet role can be the shift's responsible professional.
team.schedule.noLicenseWarning: This professional has no licence on file. The rota is the proof that there was a responsible veterinarian, with name AND licence.
schedule.clickHint: Click a shift to see its team, or an empty slot to create one.
schedule.everyoneIn: Everyone is already on this shift.
schedule.willBeResponsible: Joins as the responsible vet, because this shift does not have one yet.
